verdict.rationale: Productboard supports headless, scriptable automation through its documented REST API v2. That includes personal access tokens explicitly meant for internal tools and scripts, full CRUD on feedback and documents, cursor-based pagination, and webhooks for event-driven pipelines. However, there is no CLI, no CI-specific tooling or guidance, and the MCP server relies on interactive browser sign-in, so automation means hand-building API integrations. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. a GitHub Action), non-interactive auth for the MCP/agent path, and independent hands-on corroboration.
